# Concept exports (generated - do not edit)

Generated by `python3 mechanical/concept/microscout_concept.py`. CAD/mesh files cannot carry a text status header, so this file carries it for all of them.

- `frame_pa11.*`, `canopy_tpu.*`, `battery_strap.*`: parametric concept geometry (STEP, STL, 3MF). **Not print-ready**: no fit coupons, tolerances or drop tests yet (G5).
- Every other part (motors, props, battery, boards, module, camera, sensors, LEDs) is a **simplified envelope, APPROXIMATE**, not a manufacturer model.
- `microscout_concept_assembly.step` and `microscout_concept.glb`: the whole concept (the GLB is copied to `docs/models/` for the web viewer).
- `concept_report.json`: printed-part volumes and masses, frame bounding box, interference check, prop tip clearance.
